note.title: sum and possum
note.overview: Present sum: sum, es, est, sumus, estis, sunt. Imperfect: eram, eras, erat, eramus, eratis, erant.
learningGoals: Recall the taught forms and facts independently.
Apply them to translation and GCSE-style questions.
Use the answer and individual mark points to improve precision.
summary: Present sum: sum, es, est, sumus, estis, sunt. Imperfect: eram, eras, erat, eramus, eratis, erant.
Present possum: possum, potes, potest, possumus, potestis, possunt. Imperfect: poteram, poteras, poterat, poteramus, poteratis, poterant.
Use a finite form of possum with an infinitive: navigare possunt means they can sail. Non reverses the ability; invenire non poterat means he could not find.
